commands.title: docker compose up -d
commands.descriptionLong: Starts all services defined in your compose file in the background. Containers keep running after you close the terminal.

commands.title: docker compose logs -f
commands.descriptionLong: Streams live output from all services in the current Compose project.

commands.title: docker ps
commands.descriptionLong: Shows containers currently running on this machine.

commands.title: docker compose down
commands.descriptionLong: Stops and removes containers and networks created by the current Compose project.

commands.title: docker system prune -a
commands.descriptionLong: Removes unused containers, networks, images, and build cache. Review Docker's prompt before confirming.

commands.title: git status
commands.descriptionLong: Shows staged, modified, and untracked files in the current repository.

commands.title: git pull --rebase
commands.descriptionLong: Fetches upstream commits and reapplies your local commits on top.

commands.title: git add .
commands.descriptionLong: Stages changes under the current directory for the next commit.

commands.title: git commit -m ""
commands.descriptionShort: Create a commit with a message
commands.descriptionLong: Fill in the quoted message before running this command.

commands.title: git push
commands.descriptionLong: Sends local commits to the configured upstream branch.

commands.title: ssh homelab
commands.descriptionLong: Uses the homelab host entry from your SSH config.

commands.title: sudo dnf update
commands.descriptionLong: Downloads and installs available package updates after showing a review prompt.

commands.title: sudo dnf install
commands.descriptionLong: Add a package name before running.

commands.title: journalctl -xe
commands.descriptionLong: Opens the system journal near its end with explanatory messages.

commands.title: journalctl -f
commands.descriptionLong: Streams new system journal entries as they arrive.

commands.title: systemctl restart docker
commands.descriptionLong: Restarts the Docker system service. You may need elevated privileges.

commands.title: df -h
commands.descriptionLong: Shows free and used space on mounted filesystems in readable units.

commands.title: lsblk
commands.descriptionLong: Shows disks, partitions, and their mount points.

commands.title: free -h
commands.descriptionLong: Displays available and used memory in readable units.

commands.title: pnpm dev
commands.descriptionLong: Runs the project's dev script from its current directory.

commands.title: pnpm install
commands.descriptionLong: Installs dependencies from the current project's lockfile.

commands.title: npx expo start
commands.descriptionLong: Starts Metro and the Expo development tools.

commands.title: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081
commands.descriptionLong: Makes the host's Metro port reachable from a connected Android device.

commands.title: tailscale status
commands.descriptionLong: Lists peers and their current connectivity in your tailnet.
